CASE 01 // SOLUTION
THE ENVELOPE THAT WAS NEVER DELIVERED
HAPPY MAKERS / DETECTIVE ACADEMY
179
SOLUTION FILE // VERIFIED RESULT
ANSWER: KNOX at D2
HOW THE EVIDENCE FITS
01
QUILL is in row 1 and PIP is in row 3.
02
MORSE is in column C and KNOX is in
column D.
03
Every helper must use a different row and
a different column.
04
Columns C and D are already taken by
MORSE and KNOX, so QUILL and PIP
must use A and B.
05
PIP is left of QUILL, which makes PIP A3
and QUILL B1.
06
Rows 1 and 3 are now used. MORSE and
KNOX must use rows 2 and 4.
07
MORSE is in a lower row than KNOX, so
MORSE is C4 and KNOX is D2.
08
D2 is inside Delivery.
WHY IT MATTERS
The first file teaches the Academy method properly: combine different clue types, then use elimination
to finish the grid.

CASE 05 // SOLUTION
DILO'S CODE THAT DEFINITELY WASN'T 123456
HAPPY MAKERS / DETECTIVE ACADEMY
187
SOLUTION FILE // VERIFIED RESULT
ANSWER: BALL -> STAR -> BOLT -> HEART -> KEY -> MOON
HOW THE EVIDENCE FITS
01
STAR must sit immediately before BOLT.
02
BALL must be somewhere before STAR.
03
HEART must come after BOLT and
cannot be fifth.
04
KEY must come before MOON.
05
HEART must also come before MOON.
06
Testing the possible positions leaves one
sequence: BALL -> STAR -> BOLT ->
HEART -> KEY -> MOON.
WHY IT MATTERS
The code opens the dormant locker and reveals an old routing card stamped 0 and marked
INCOMPLETE. The code itself is saved for the final lock.
